title: tasks-vault/1
description: The optional marker file `tasks-vault.json` in the root of a tasks vault: layout version, extra areas and defaults. Read by the engine; written once by `:TasksVault create`. No data classes, no paths, no code: the vault is synced. An unknown key or a newer version is refused (fail closed).

layout_version.description: Version of the folder layout (migrations hang on it).

extra_areas.description: Folders of the vault that are areas although they hold neither ROADMAP/ nor Backlog/.

lang.description: Language of the body of a new task when the caller names none.

strict.description: Warnings fail the CI gate too. `trust_vault_lint` is never read from the file.
